limitations: Generated callers are diagnostic evidence, not human voice or accent/noise acceptance. Operator pauses inflate durations and are not an AHT benchmark.

The first journey needed clearer generated code speech. Two groups of three digits verified successfully; the subsequent complete journey verified on its first tool attempt. Recognition remains a pilot concern.
Malformed or missing display fields were exercised in mocked text checks, not injected into the live TMS. The deployed service requires valid shipment timestamps.
The full text sweep and additional boundary checks include retained failures; audio passes do not overwrite them.
The owner must record the walkthrough. No submission video or portal upload is claimed.
sanitization: Verification speech, code arguments and private contact/claim fields omitted. Private audio remains outside Git; hashes identify it. Long dash punctuation normalized.
